root_cause: Production traces show the first three PostgREST calls SOURCES, PUBLICATIONS, EXTERNAL_SIGNALS taking 90-197 s before failure; bounded concurrency without a request deadline allows connections to remain occupied.
intervention: Send AbortSignal.timeout to the real PostgREST request, reduce stage concurrency from 3 to 2, 3800 ms max per stage, preserve ten data stages and existing tenant filter; fail closed on missing data.
prevention: No orphan PostgREST queries, no partial success, no fake values or tenant intermixing; production acceptance still requires recovered database capacity.
